lambda:VpcIds.documentation: Filters access by the ID of the VPC configured for the AWS Lambda function

lambda:SubnetIds.documentation: Filters access by the ID of subnets configured for the AWS Lambda function

lambda:Layer.documentation: Filters access by the ARN of a version of an AWS Lambda layer

lambda:EventSourceToken.documentation: Filters access by the ID from a non-AWS event source configured for the AWS Lambda function

lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType.documentation: Filters access by authorization type specified in request. Available during CreateFunctionUrlConfig, UpdateFunctionUrlConfig, DeleteFunctionUrlConfig, GetFunctionUrlConfig, ListFunctionUrlConfig, AddPermission and RemovePermission operations

aws:RequestTag/${TagKey}.documentation: Filters access by the tags that are passed in the request

aws:ResourceTag/${TagKey}.documentation: Filters access by the tags associated with the resource

lambda:CodeSigningConfigArn.documentation: Filters access by the ARN of an AWS Lambda code signing config

lambda:FunctionArn.documentation: Filters access by the ARN of an AWS Lambda function

aws:TagKeys.documentation: Filters access by the tag keys that are passed in the request

lambda:SourceFunctionArn.documentation: Filters access by the ARN of the AWS Lambda function from which the request originated

lambda:SecurityGroupIds.documentation: Filters access by the ID of security groups configured for the AWS Lambda function

lambda:Principal.documentation: Filters access by restricting the AWS service or account that can invoke a function

aws.iam#iamAction.documentation: Grants permission to view details about an AWS Lambda function

aws.iam#iamAction.name: InvokeFunction
aws.iam#iamAction.documentation: Grants permission to invoke an AWS Lambda function
Grants permission to retrieve a list of AWS Lambda functions, with the version-specific configuration of each function
